name: touch-playthrough
description: #120: the M3 exit chain, played with touch-layer actions only. One scenario that grows stretch by stretch (63 of 64 Tier 2 slots were taken); the input is the generated segments touch-1-first-battle, touch-2-md1-1-probe (runner/test/unit/playthrough-scenarios.js; a Tier 1 test checks the files). Each stretch ends on a wait.until, and a timeout fails the scenario. End checks: still in md1_1 (0x75) in field mode with Cloud's HP above 0, and a rerun matches (checks without metrics). Metrics (probe for stretch 2): gw0_to/gw1_to are the fields gateways 0 and 1 lead to; g0x/g0y/g1x/g1y the signs of each gateway's first end minus the player's position; up_dx/up_dy the signs of the player's PosX/PosY change over the 20-frame drag up. Only field IDs, signs and 1/0 leave.
